name: Archivist
resourceDesc: Mana pays for every song and spell; one song (Cadence or Dirge) can be sung at a time.
identity: A song-caster of the Silent Pilgrims: little damage, the purest crowd control. Lull a pull to sleep, bind the worst of it, hush the casters. (GAME-ONLY kit on CANON roots: the Original Song, the echo-jars.)

branches.name: The Silent Vow
branches.loop: Hush the blow or the cast that matters; keep the casters quiet.

nodes.name: Quick Hush
nodes.desc: Hush's cooldown is 2 seconds shorter per rank.

nodes.name: Long Hush
nodes.desc: Hush silences 1 second longer per rank.

nodes.name: Still Air
nodes.desc: A hushed mob is also slowed 20% per rank for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: The Vow
nodes.desc: Hush also stuns for 1 second.

nodes.name: Quiet Step
nodes.desc: Mobs notice you 1 metre closer per rank.

nodes.name: No Word
nodes.desc: A silenced mob takes 5% more damage from your party per rank.

nodes.name: The Great Silence
nodes.desc: Hush silences every mob within 6 metres of the target.

branches.name: The Lull
branches.loop: Lull the pull before it starts; keep the sleepers asleep; Unsong the one that wakes.
branches.tradeoff: The longest holds, and nothing else.

nodes.name: Deep Sleep
nodes.desc: Lull lasts 2 seconds longer per rank.

nodes.name: Unsong
nodes.desc: A mob woken from Lull or Echo Bind by damage is slowed by half for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Soft Voice
nodes.desc: Lull's cooldown is 5 seconds shorter per rank.

nodes.name: Wide Lull
nodes.desc: Lull reaches 1 metre further around the target per rank.

nodes.name: A Fourth Sleeper
nodes.desc: Lull takes up to four mobs.

nodes.name: Dreams
nodes.desc: Lull costs 5 less Mana per rank.

nodes.name: Mesmer
nodes.desc: Echo Bind on a boss stuns it for 4 seconds instead of failing.

branches.name: The Archive
branches.loop: Shard Note between holds; Echo-jar when the pull goes wrong; sing the right song.

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.desc: Shard Note hits 4% harder per rank.

nodes.name: A Fuller Jar
nodes.desc: Echo-jar's fear lasts 2 seconds longer per rank.

nodes.name: Chorus
nodes.desc: While you sing Cadence, your party hits 2% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Low Dirge
nodes.desc: Dirge slows 10% more per rank.

nodes.name: A Second Jar
nodes.desc: Echo-jar's cooldown is 30 seconds shorter.

nodes.name: The Catalogue
nodes.desc: Shard Note hits a silenced or fleeing mob 25% harder.

nodes.name: The Original Song
nodes.desc: The Original Song: the first Lull of each fight takes every mob within 10 metres of the target.

branches.name: The Cantor
branches.loop: Sing the Song of Mending under the fight, a Mending Phrase on whoever falls behind, and the Chorus when the blow everyone sees coming lands.
branches.tradeoff: A Cantor's songs are its healing: singing the Song of Mending means no Cadence and no Dirge, and its holds wait while it mends.

nodes.name: Clear Voice
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase heals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Breath
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase is sung 0.15s quicker per rank.

nodes.name: Held Note
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase leaves a held note: 1% of maximum health a second for 5s per rank.

nodes.name: Chorus of the Weave
nodes.desc: New action: Chorus of the Weave: every party member within 15m takes a barrier for 8s.

nodes.name: Long Song
nodes.desc: The Song of Mending mends 0.5% more of maximum health a second per rank.

nodes.name: Echoing Mend
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase on someone below 35% health heals 30% more.

nodes.name: Resonant Ward
nodes.desc: Chorus of the Weave's barriers are 25% larger per rank.

nodes.name: Quiet Mind
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase costs 3 less Mana per rank.

nodes.name: The Weave
nodes.desc: The Song of Mending reaches 2m further per rank.

nodes.name: Symphony of Mending
nodes.desc: Chorus of the Weave also heals each ally it shields for 8% of maximum health.

nodes.name: Second Voice
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase also heals the next most hurt for 30% of it per rank.

nodes.name: Desert of Echoes
nodes.desc: The Song of Mending can be sung beside Cadence or Dirge: two songs at once.

nodes.name: Last Verse
nodes.desc: An ally who would fall within your Song is left at 1 health instead, once every 60/45/30s.

nodes.name: Choir
nodes.desc: Chorus of the Weave's cooldown is halved.

nodes.name: The Mending Song
nodes.desc: Once a fight, sing the whole party back to full health.
